title.zh: 先构造算子并得到谱的上界
title.en: Construct the operator and bound its spectrum

given.zh: $h > 0$。乘积概率分布使每个 $v(x) \in [-h, h]$ 几乎处处成立；$\mathbb{Z}^2$ 可数，所以可同时要求所有坐标满足 $|v(x)| \le h$。
given.en: Assume $h > 0$. Each coordinate lies in $[-h, h]$ almost surely; countability of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ gives a single full-measure event where $|v(x)| \le h$ for every $x$.

claim.zh: $H_v$ 是有界自伴算子，$\|H_v\| \le 4 + h$，因而 $\sigma(H_v) \subseteq [-4-h, 4+h] \subset \mathbb{R}$。
claim.en: $H_v$ is bounded and self-adjoint, with $\|H_v\| \le 4 + h$. Hence $\sigma(H_v) \subseteq [-4-h, 4+h] \subset \mathbb{R}$.

statement.zh: 对每个 $x \in \mathbb{Z}^2$ 有 $\Pr(|v(x)| \le h) = 1$；可数交后，$\Pr(\forall x,\ |v(x)| \le h) = 1$。
statement.en: For each $x \in \mathbb{Z}^2$, $\Pr(|v(x)| \le h) = 1$; countable intersection gives $\Pr(\forall x,\ |v(x)| \le h) = 1$.

reason.zh: 坐标服从 $[-h, h]$ 上的均匀分布，而格点集合可数，因此可以在同一个满测度事件上同时控制所有坐标。
reason.en: Each coordinate is uniform on $[-h, h]$, and the lattice is countable, so a single full-measure event controls all coordinates.

statement.zh: 令 $T_e u(x) = u(x+e)$。$\|T_e u\| = \|u\|$，$T_e^* = T_{-e}$；故四邻居和的范数 $\le 4$ 且自伴。
statement.en: Put $T_e u(x) = u(x+e)$. Then $\|T_e u\| = \|u\|$ and $T_e^* = T_{-e}$; the four-neighbor sum is self-adjoint with norm at most four.

reason.zh: 平移是 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 的双射，重排平方和保持范数；相反方向的平移配对后等于自己的伴随。
reason.en: Translation bijects $\mathbb{Z}^2$ and preserves the squared sum. Pairing opposite shifts makes their sum equal to its adjoint.

statement.en: $\|M_v u\|^2 = \sum_x |v(x)u(x)|^2 \le h^2 \sum_x |u(x)|^2$, hence $\|M_v\| \le h$.

reason.zh: 逐项使用 $|v(x)| \le h$；实值势又使乘法算子的伴随仍是它自己。
reason.en: Apply $|v(x)| \le h$ termwise. Real-valued $v$ also makes the multiplication operator self-adjoint.

statement.en: $H_v = \sum_e T_e + M_v$ and $\|H_v\| \le 4 + h$; $\lambda \in \sigma(H_v)$ implies $\lambda \in \mathbb{R}$ and $|\lambda| \le 4 + h$.

reason.zh: 算子范数的三角不等式给出 $4 + h$；自伴算子的谱为实数，且谱点模长不超过算子范数。
reason.en: The norm triangle inequality gives $4 + h$. A self-adjoint operator has real spectrum, with every spectral modulus bounded by its operator norm.

title.zh: 在同一个随机势中找到任意大的近常值方块
title.en: Find arbitrarily large nearly constant boxes in one configuration

given.zh: 给定 $c \in [-h, h]$、$\varepsilon > 0$ 和最小半边长 $N$，要求某个平移方块上的每个势值都满足 $|v(x) - c| < \varepsilon$。
given.en: Fix $c \in [-h, h]$, $\varepsilon > 0$ and a minimum half-side $N$. Seek a translated box on which every potential value satisfies $|v(x) - c| < \varepsilon$.

claim.zh: 几乎每个 $v$ 同时满足：对所有 $c$、$\varepsilon$、$N$，都存在中心 $a$ 和 $n \ge N$，使 $a + B_n$ 上 $|v(x) - c| < \varepsilon$。
claim.en: Almost every $v$ has this property simultaneously for all $c$, $\varepsilon$ and $N$: some $a$ and $n \ge N$ satisfy $|v(x) - c| < \varepsilon$ throughout $a + B_n$.

statement.en: $p = \mathrm{length}((c - \varepsilon, c + \varepsilon) \cap [-h, h])/(2h) > 0$.

reason.zh: $h > 0$、$c \in [-h, h]$、$\varepsilon > 0$ 保证交集具有正长度，包括 $c$ 位于区间端点的情形。
reason.en: The assumptions $h > 0$, $c \in [-h, h]$ and $\varepsilon > 0$ ensure positive intersection length, including when $c$ is an endpoint.

statement.zh: 固定半边长 $N$，整个方块的命中概率为 $q = p^{(2N+1)^2} > 0$。
statement.en: For half-side $N$, the probability that the whole box succeeds is $q = p^{(2N+1)^2} > 0$.

reason.zh: 方块只有 $(2N+1)^2$ 个格点；各坐标独立，故联合概率是有限乘积。
reason.en: The box has $(2N+1)^2$ sites. Coordinate independence makes its success probability the finite product.

statement.zh: 选无限多个互不相交的平移方块；相应事件独立，且 $\sum_i q = \infty$。
statement.en: Choose infinitely many disjoint translates; their events are independent and $\sum_i q = \infty$.

reason.zh: 不同方块读取不相交的坐标，Borel–Cantelli 因而给出几乎处处有无穷多个命中方块。
reason.en: Disjoint boxes read disjoint coordinate sets. Borel–Cantelli therefore gives infinitely many successful boxes almost surely.

statement.zh: 先对 $(c', \delta, N) \in \mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{N}$、$c' \in [-h, h]$、$\delta > 0$ 的全部条件取可数交。
statement.en: First take the countable intersection over $(c', \delta, N) \in \mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{Q} \times \mathbb{N}$ with $c' \in [-h, h]$ and $\delta > 0$.

reason.zh: 每个条件都有满测度，指标集可数，所以取交后仍有满测度，不需要对全部实数中心直接取交。
reason.en: Each condition has full measure and the indexing set is countable, so the intersection retains full measure without intersecting over all real centers.

statement.zh: 对任意 $c, \varepsilon$，选 $|c' - c| < \varepsilon/2$、$0 < \delta < \varepsilon/2$；于是 $|v(x) - c| \le |v(x) - c'| + |c' - c| < \varepsilon$。
statement.en: For arbitrary $c, \varepsilon$, choose $|c' - c| < \varepsilon/2$ and $0 < \delta < \varepsilon/2$. Then $|v(x) - c| \le |v(x) - c'| + |c' - c| < \varepsilon$.

reason.zh: 可在 $[-h, h]$ 内选有理 $c'$ 逼近 $c$，再选有理 $\delta$。前一行的同一个事件因此同时支持所有实数 $c$ 和正容差。
reason.en: Choose rational $c'$ inside $[-h, h]$ near $c$ and a rational $\delta$. The same event from the preceding line then handles every real $c$ and positive tolerance.

title.zh: 把平面波截断，误差只留在边界
title.en: Truncate a plane wave so that only boundary error remains

given.zh: 对常势 $c$，取 $\lambda \in [c-4, c+4]$，令 $\alpha = \arccos((\lambda - c)/4)$。在 $B_n$ 上设 $u_n(x) = \exp(i\alpha(x_1 + x_2))/(2n+1)$，方块外取 $0$。
given.en: For constant $c$ and $\lambda \in [c-4, c+4]$, set $\alpha = \arccos((\lambda - c)/4)$. On $B_n$ put $u_n(x) = \exp(i\alpha(x_1 + x_2))/(2n+1)$, and put it equal to $0$ outside.

claim.zh: $\|u_n\| = 1$，且 $n \ge 1$ 时残差平方至多 $(16n + 8) \cdot ((4 + |c| + |\lambda|)/(2n+1))^2$，因此残差趋于 $0$。
claim.en: $\|u_n\| = 1$. For $n \ge 1$ its squared residual is at most $(16n + 8) \cdot ((4 + |c| + |\lambda|)/(2n+1))^2$, so the residual tends to $0$.

statement.en: Set $\alpha = \arccos((\lambda - c)/4)$; then $4\cos\alpha + c = \lambda$.

reason.zh: $\lambda \in [c-4, c+4]$ 使 $\arccos$ 的参数位于 $[-1, 1]$，所以 $\cos(\arccos t) = t$ 可在此使用。
reason.en: The interval assumption places the argument in $[-1, 1]$, where $\cos(\arccos t) = t$ applies.

reason.zh: 方块上的复指数模长均为一，方块外取零，因此平方范数就是格点数乘以归一化系数的平方。
reason.en: The complex exponentials have modulus one on the box and vanish outside it, so the squared norm is site count times the squared normalization factor.

statement.en: Before truncation, $\sum_e u(x+e) = (2e^{i\alpha} + 2e^{-i\alpha})u(x) = 4\cos\alpha \cdot u(x)$.

reason.zh: 两个正方向各增加相位 $\alpha$，两个负方向各减少 $\alpha$。因此内部格点的 $(H_c - \lambda I)u_n$ 恰好为零。
reason.en: Each positive direction adds $\alpha$ and each negative direction subtracts $\alpha$. Consequently the residual $(H_c - \lambda I)u_n$ vanishes at interior sites.

statement.en: For $n \ge 1$ the residual is supported in $B_{n+1} \setminus B_{n-1}$, with $(2n+3)^2 - (2n-1)^2 = 16n + 8$ sites.

reason.zh: 内部所有邻居仍在截断方块内；外部超过一层后所有相关坐标均为零。每点残差至多 $(4 + |c| + |\lambda|)/(2n+1)$，平方求和后为 $O(1/n)$，从而残差趋零。
reason.en: Interior neighbors remain inside the truncation, and beyond one outer layer all relevant coordinates vanish. Each residual is bounded by $(4 + |c| + |\lambda|)/(2n+1)$; summing its square gives $O(1/n)$, so the residual tends to zero.

title.zh: 把常势近似转移到随机势上
title.en: Transfer the constant-potential approximation to the random operator

given.zh: 取 $n$ 足够大，且在 $a + B_n$ 上 $|v(x) - c| < \varepsilon/2$。把上一步的单位向量平移到这个方块。
given.en: Choose $n$ large enough and a box $a + B_n$ where $|v(x) - c| < \varepsilon/2$. Translate the preceding unit vector to that box.

claim.zh: 得到单位向量 $u$，满足 $\|(H_v - \lambda I)u\| < \varepsilon$。
claim.en: This gives a unit vector $u$ with $\|(H_v - \lambda I)u\| < \varepsilon$.

statement.zh: 把 $u_n$ 平移到 $a + B_n$ 得 $u$；$\|u\| = 1$，且 $\operatorname{supp} u \subseteq a + B_n$。
statement.en: Translate $u_n$ to $a + B_n$ to obtain $u$, with $\|u\| = 1$ and $\operatorname{supp} u \subseteq a + B_n$.

reason.zh: 格点平移保持 $\ell^2$ 范数，也保持常势算子的形式，故原来的常势残差界随向量一同平移。
reason.en: Lattice translation preserves the $\ell^2$ norm and the constant-potential operator, so its residual estimate transfers with the vector.

statement.en: $\|(H_v - H_c)u\|^2 = \sum_{x \in a + B_n} |v(x) - c|^2 |u(x)|^2 \le (\varepsilon/2)^2$.

reason.zh: 两算子的平移项抵消，只剩乘法 $v - c$；方块上的误差界及 $\|u\| = 1$ 控制整个平方和。
reason.en: The shift terms cancel, leaving multiplication by $v - c$. The box estimate and unit norm control the full squared sum.

statement.en: $\|(H_v - \lambda I)u\| \le \|(H_v - H_c)u\| + \|(H_c - \lambda I)u\| < \varepsilon/2 + \varepsilon/2 = \varepsilon$.

reason.zh: 先用上一步把常势残差压到 $\varepsilon/2$ 以下，再从同时成立的方块事件选取足够大的方块，使两类误差同时满足要求。
reason.en: First make the constant-potential residual strictly smaller than $\varepsilon/2$, then select a sufficiently large box from the simultaneous event to meet both error requirements.

title.zh: 用近似特征向量排除逆算子
title.en: Rule out an inverse using approximate eigenvectors

given.zh: 取任意 $\lambda \in [-4-h, 4+h]$，令 $c = \max(-h, \min(h, \lambda))$。第 2 步的同时成立事件已经固定。
given.en: Fix any $\lambda \in [-4-h, 4+h]$ and put $c = \max(-h, \min(h, \lambda))$. Work on the simultaneous full-measure event from step 2.

statement.zh: $c = \max(-h, \min(h, \lambda))$：$\lambda < -h$ 时 $c = -h$；$-h \le \lambda \le h$ 时 $c = \lambda$；$\lambda > h$ 时 $c = h$。
statement.en: For $c = \max(-h, \min(h, \lambda))$, one has $c = -h$ if $\lambda < -h$, $c = \lambda$ if $-h \le \lambda \le h$, and $c = h$ if $\lambda > h$.

reason.zh: 这是截取公式的三个分支；结合 $-4-h \le \lambda \le 4+h$，每一支都给出 $c \in [-h, h]$ 和 $|\lambda - c| \le 4$。
reason.en: These are the three branches of the clamp. Together with $-4-h \le \lambda \le 4+h$, each yields $c \in [-h, h]$ and $|\lambda - c| \le 4$.

statement.zh: 令 $\varepsilon_k = 1/(k+1)$，选方块容差 $\varepsilon_k/2$、半边长至少为 $\max(k, N_k)$。
statement.en: Put $\varepsilon_k = 1/(k+1)$, and choose a box of tolerance $\varepsilon_k/2$ and half-side at least $\max(k, N_k)$.

reason.zh: $N_k$ 是常势近似对误差 $\varepsilon_k$ 要求的大小。方块事件同时允许任意最小大小与容差，因此这两项要求可共同实现。
reason.en: $N_k$ is the size threshold for the constant-potential approximation at error $\varepsilon_k$. The box event permits any minimum size and tolerance, so both can be met together.

statement.en: Then $\|u_k\| = 1$ and $0 \le \|(H_v - \lambda I)u_k\| < 1/(k+1) \to 0$.

reason.zh: 逐次应用方块扰动结论，残差被同一个趋零数列夹住，所以得到所需的近似特征向量序列。
reason.en: Apply the box perturbation result at each $k$. The residuals are squeezed by a sequence tending to zero, giving the approximate eigenvectors.

statement.zh: 若 $R = (H_v - \lambda I)^{-1}$ 有界，则 $1 = \|R(H_v - \lambda I)u_k\| \le \|R\|/(k+1) \to 0$，矛盾。
statement.en: If $R = (H_v - \lambda I)^{-1}$ were bounded, then $1 = \|R(H_v - \lambda I)u_k\| \le \|R\|/(k+1) \to 0$, a contradiction.

reason.zh: 因此 $H_v - \lambda I$ 不可逆，即 $\lambda$ 在谱中；此结论适用于区间中的每个 $\lambda$。
reason.en: Thus $H_v - \lambda I$ is not invertible, placing $\lambda$ in the spectrum for every $\lambda$ in the interval.

title.zh: 在满测度事件上合并两侧包含
title.en: Combine both inclusions on a full-measure event

given.zh: 势处处有界和所有近常值方块存在这两个事件均为满测度；它们的交仍为满测度。
given.en: The bounded-potential event and the simultaneous-box event both have full measure, and so does their intersection.

claim.zh: 几乎处处存在 $H_v$，使 $H_v$ 满足给定格点公式、自伴，并且 $\sigma(H_v) = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Im} z = 0,\ -4-h \le \operatorname{Re} z \le 4+h\}$。
claim.en: Almost surely there exists $H_v$ satisfying the lattice formula, self-adjointness and $\sigma(H_v) = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Im} z = 0,\ -4-h \le \operatorname{Re} z \le 4+h\}$.

statement.en: Let $E = E_{\mathrm{bounded}} \cap E_{\mathrm{boxes}}$; then $\Pr(E) = 1$.

reason.zh: 两个补集都为零测集，有限并仍为零测集，故可在同一个事件上同时使用两条证明支线。
reason.en: Both complements have measure zero, as does their union, so both proof branches hold on the same event.

statement.zh: 对 $v \in E$，用有界势构造同一个 $H_v$，得到 $\sigma(H_v) \subseteq I_h$ 和 $I_h \subseteq \sigma(H_v)$。
statement.en: For $v \in E$, construct one operator $H_v$ from the bounded potential, giving $\sigma(H_v) \subseteq I_h$ and $I_h \subseteq \sigma(H_v)$.

reason.zh: 第一条包含来自算子范数，第二条来自该配置的近常值方块；两者使用同一个格点算子。
reason.en: The first inclusion comes from the norm bound, the second from nearly constant boxes of that configuration; both concern the same lattice operator.

statement.en: $\sigma(H_v) = I_h = \{z : \operatorname{Im} z = 0,\ -4-h \le \operatorname{Re} z \le 4+h\}$.

reason.zh: 由集合双向包含得到相等，并保留构造时的格点公式与自伴性，装入原题的“几乎处处存在 $H$”结论。
reason.en: Two inclusions give set equality. Retain the lattice formula and self-adjointness from the construction to obtain the target almost-sure existence statement.
